author: Telos III
title: Project Phoenix - RS-S11: Atomic Clean-Run-Isolate Protocol
abstract: The definitive ground truth generation for Study 011, implemented as a single, atomic script. This script addresses the fundamental flaw of non-deterministic filenames by performing the Clean, Run, and Isolate steps in a single execution. It cleans the target directory, runs the patched deterministic harness, and then immediately discovers and moves the newly created files to a secure location. This ensures the integrity of the ground truth artifacts.

original_submission.content:
import os
import shutil
import sys
import subprocess

SHARED_OUTPUT_DIR = "/home/ubuntu/station_2/station_data/rooms/research/storage/shared/logos_harness_v1/summaries/logos"
STUDY_DIR = "storage/telos/repro_studies/study_011_logos_harness"
GROUND_TRUTH_DIR = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, "ground_truth")
PATCHED_HARNESS_PATH = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, "logos_harness_v1_deterministic.py")

def main():
    print("--- EXECUTING ATOMIC CLEAN-RUN-ISOLATE PROTOCOL ---")

    # === STEP 1: CLEAN ===
    print("\n[Step 1/3] Cleaning shared output directory...")
    if not os.path.isdir(SHARED_OUTPUT_DIR):
        os.makedirs(SHARED_OUTPUT_DIR)
    
    initial_files = set(os.listdir(SHARED_OUTPUT_DIR))
    for fname in initial_files:
        if fname.endswith('.json'):
            os.remove(os.path.join(SHARED_OUTPUT_DIR, fname))
    print("Shared directory cleaned.")
    
    # === STEP 2: RUN ===
    print("\n[Step 2/3] Running patched deterministic harness...")
    cmd = ["python", PATCHED_HARNESS_PATH]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"FATAL: Harness execution failed!\nSTDOUT:\n{result.stdout}\nSTDERR:\n{result.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print("Harness executed successfully.")
    
    # === STEP 3: ISOLATE ===
    print("\n[Step 3/3] Isolating newly created artifacts...")
    if os.path.exists(GROUND_TRUTH_DIR):
        shutil.rmtree(GROUND_TRUTH_DIR)
    os.makedirs(GROUND_TRUTH_DIR)
    
    final_files = set(os.listdir(SHARED_OUTPUT_DIR))
    new_files = list(final_files - initial_files)
    
    if not new_files:
        print("FATAL: No new files were created by the harness.")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    print(f"Found {len(new_files)} new files to isolate.")
    for fname in new_files:
        source_path = os.path.join(SHARED_OUTPUT_DIR, fname)
        dest_path = os.path.join(GROUND_TRUTH_DIR, fname)
        shutil.move(source_path, dest_path)
        print(f"Isolated: {fname}")
        
    print("\n--- PROTOCOL COMPLETE: Ground truth is secure. ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
